tasks.title: Optical flow speed limit
tasks.solution: ekfGndSpdLimit = (EK3_FLOW_MAX − 1 rad/s) · h: 1 rad/s for body rotation is subtracted from the sensor limit, and the rest is multiplied by the height (before 4.7 the parameter was called EK3_MAX_FLOW). At 1 m with 2.5 rad/s that is only 1.5 m/s: you cannot fly fast low over the floor.

tasks.title: Estimate lag from an uncompensated delay
tasks.solution: e = v · (τ − VISO_DELAY_MS). The EKF assigns the measurement to the moment "received − VISO_DELAY_MS"; whatever the parameter does not cover becomes a lag of v·Δτ. This is a lower bound: in the lab, at Δτ = 200 ms and 1.5 m/s the p95 error is 0.51 m instead of 0.30 m, because the position loop starts to oscillate.

tasks.title: Position innovation gate
tasks.solution: The test in FuseVelPosNED: (ΔN² + ΔE²) / [(g/100)² · (var_N + var_E)] < 1, where var = σ_P² + σ_R². The limit is |Δ| = (g/100) · √(2·(σ_P² + σ_R²)). A larger jump means the measurements are rejected, and after 7–10 s the EKF resets the position to the source.

tasks.title: Calibrating FLOW_FXSCALER
tasks.solution: The flow is multiplied by (1 + FLOW_FXSCALER/1000). You need (1 + k/1000)·flow = body → k = (body/flow − 1)·1000. The allowed range is ±800; a value beyond ±200 is a reason to check the lens and the orientation rather than keep turning the knob.
